name: application-waterfall-chart
title: Waterfall Chart
description: Sequential increase/decrease bar chart with a running total — bar start/end positions are computed from real step deltas, showing how a starting value bridges to an ending value through a series of changes.
useWhen: Showing how a starting value changes step by step to reach an ending value (e.g. revenue bridge, budget variance).
Both positive and negative contributions matter and should be visually distinguished.
You want bar positions computed from real deltas rather than hand-placed pixel offsets.
avoidWhen: The steps aren't sequential/cumulative — use a plain bar chart instead.
You only have a start and end value with no intermediate steps — use big-number-delta-tile instead.
You need to show more than one bridge/series at once — this component renders a single sequence.
responsiveBehavior: Bars are flex-1 within their row so they redistribute width evenly as the container resizes; the chart height is fixed (default 160px).
accessibility: Each bar carries role='img' with an aria-label stating the step name and its signed value (e.g. "Churn: -30"), since bar position/height alone isn't announced by screen readers.
Every bar's value is also shown as visible text above its label.
Total (starting/ending) bars use a neutral color distinct from the green/red positive/negative bars, so the anchor points are visually distinguishable from the deltas.

variants.title: Waterfall chart
variants.description: Six-step Q3 revenue bridge (Starting revenue → New sales → Upsells → Churn → Refunds → Ending revenue), on a light surface.
accessibility: Bar color (green/red/gray) is supplementary; the signed numeric label carries the meaning.

variants.title: Waterfall chart (Dark)
variants.description: The same six-step revenue bridge, adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Bar and text colors must meet WCAG AA contrast on dark backgrounds.
